description: List API classes and methods for a product. Returns structured class/method names with summaries. Pages with offset/limit (nextOffset is returned while more remain); summary=true returns member counts per class instead. Use this to explore available APIs.

offset.description: Skip this many entries (optional, default 0). Use nextOffset from the previous page.

summary.description: Return member counts per class instead of the member list (optional)

name: get_api_list
title: List API members
